verses.sanskrit:
भीमसेन उवाच।
              स्मरन्ति वैरं रक्षांसि मायामाश्रित्य मोहिनीम्। हिडिम्बे व्रज पन्थानं त्वमिमं भ्रातृसेवितम्॥१॥
verses.english: Bhima said: woman even The Rakshasas revenge themselves on their enemy by alluring deceptions. Therefore, O Hidimba, go to the way that your brother has gone.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              क्रुद्धोऽपि पुरुषव्याघ्र भीम मा स्म स्त्रियं वधीः। शरीरगुत्यभ्यधिकं धर्म गोपाय पाण्डव॥२॥
verses.english: Yudhisthira said: O best of men, O Bhima do not kill a in anger. O Pandava, the attainment of virtue is a higher duty than the protection of body.

verses.sanskrit: वधाभिप्रायमायांतमवधीस्त्वं महाबलम्। रक्षसस्तस्य भगिनी किं नः क्रुद्धा करिष्यति॥३॥
verses.english: You have killed the greatly powerful (Rakshasas) who came with the purpose of killing us. She is (but) his sister, what can she do to us, even if she is angry?

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              हिडिम्बा तु ततः कुन्तीमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। युधिष्ठिरं तु कौन्तेयमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, Hidimba respectfully saluting Kunti and Yudhisthira with joined hands, spoke to Kunti thus, “O respected lady, you know the pangs that women suffer from the god of love. O blessed lady, I have received those (pangs) by Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: आर्ये जानासि यद्दुःखमिह स्त्रीणामनङ्गजम्। तदिदं मामनुप्राप्तं भीमसेनकृतं शुभे॥५॥
सोढं तत्परमं दुःखं मया कालप्रतीक्षया। सोऽयमभ्यागतः कालो भविता मे सुखोदयः॥६॥
verses.english: I have suffered these great pangs and I wait for the time (when it will be assuaged). That time has now come, when I expect that my happiness would come.

verses.sanskrit: मयाह्युत्सृज्य सुहृदः स्वधर्मं स्वजनं तथा। वृतोऽयं पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तव पुत्रः पतिः शुभे॥७॥
verses.english: O blessed lady, leaving my friends relatives and religion, I have chosen this best of men, this son of yours, as my husband.

verses.sanskrit: वीरेणाऽहं तथानेन त्वया चापि यशस्विनि। प्रत्याख्याता न जीवामि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥८॥
verses.english: O illustrious lady, if forsaken by this hero and yourself I shall not live any longer, I tell you this truly.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्हसि कृपां कर्तुं मयि त्वं वरवर्णिनि। मत्वा मूढेति तन्मां त्वं भक्ता वाऽनुगतेति वा ॥९॥
verses.english: O greatly beautiful lady, you should show compassion towards me, considering me foolish or very obedient to you.

verses.sanskrit: भर्त्राऽनेन महाभागे संयोजय सुतेन ह। तमुपादाय गच्छेयं यथेष्टं देवरूपिणम्। पुनश्चैवानयिष्यामि विस्रम्भं कुरु मे शुभे॥१०॥
verses.english: O greatly fortunate lady, unite me with my husband, your son. Let me go away at pleasure (wherever I like), taking this celestial like (hero). Trust me, O blessed lady, I shall bring him back to you all.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि मनसा ध्याता सर्वान्नष्यामि वः सदा। वृजिनात्तारयिष्यामि दुर्गेषु विषमेषु च॥११॥
verses.english: Whenever you will think of me I will immediately come to you and carry you wherever you will command. I shall rescue you from danger over even and uneven grounds. I shall carry you on my back whenever you will desire to proceed with speed. Be gracious to me and make Bhimasena accept me.

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठेन वो वहिष्यामि शीघ्रं गतिमभीप्सतः। यूयं प्रसादं कुरुत भीमसेनो भजेत माम्॥१२॥
आपदस्तरणे प्राणान्धारयेधेन तेन वा। सर्वमावृत्य कर्तव्यं तं धर्ममनुवर्तता॥१३॥
verses.english: It is consonant with the precepts of religion that one should protect his life by any means. He, who seeks to do it, should not scruple about the means.
verses.bhavadeepa: वहिष्यामि प्रापयिष्यामि आर्ष इट् प्रवक्ष्यामीति पाठेऽपिवहेरेव रूपम् । गतिं गम्यं देशम् ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: आपत्सु यो धारयति धर्मं धर्मविदुत्तमः। व्यसनं ह्येव धर्मस्य धर्मिणामापदुच्यते॥१४॥
verses.english: He who keeps his virtue (even) in distress in the foremost of all virtuous men. Distress is the greatest danger to virtue and virtuous men.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं प्राणान्धारयति पुण्यं प्राणदमुच्यते। येन येनाचरेद्धर्मं तस्मिन्गर्हा न विद्यते॥१५॥
verses.english: 'It is virtue that protect life and therefore virtue is called the giver of life. The means by which virtue is secured be censurable.'

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वं हिडिम्बे नात्र संशयः। स्थातव्यं तु त्वया सत्ये यथा ब्रूयां सुमध्यमे॥१६॥
verses.english: Yudhisthira said: Hidimba, there is no doubt of that what you say is true. O lady of slender waist, you must act as you have said (you want to do).

verses.sanskrit: स्नातं कृताह्निकं भद्रे कृतकौतुकमङ्गलम्। भीमसेनं भजेथास्त्वं प्रागस्तगमनाद्रवेः॥१७॥
verses.english: O blessed lady, when Bhimasena will finished ablutions, twilight prayer and the usual propitiatory rites you will then be adored by him till the sun sets.

verses.sanskrit: अहःसु विहरानेन यथाकामं मनोजवा। अयं त्वानयितव्यस्ते भीमसेनः सदा निशि॥१८॥
verses.english: O lady of mind like speed, sport with him at pleasure during the day. You must always bring Bhimasena back every night. can never

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              तथेति तत्प्रतिज्ञाय भीमसेनोऽब्रवीदिदम्। शृणु राक्षसि सत्येन समयं ते वदाम्यहम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having promised to do it by saying, “Be it so", Bhima said (to Hidimba), “O Rakshasi, listen to the agreement that I make with you.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्कालेन भवति पुत्रस्योत्पादनं शुभे। तावत्कालं गमिष्यामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे॥२०॥
verses.english: O blessed lady, O lady of slender waist, I shall go (and stay) with you, so long you do not obtain a son."

verses.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच । तथेति तत्प्रतिज्ञाय हिडिम्बा राक्षसी तदा। भीमसेनमुपादाय सोर्ध्वमाचक्रमे ततः॥२१॥
verses.english: Having promised this by saying, “Be it so," the Rakshasi Hidimba took Bhima upon her body and went up to the sky.

verses.sanskrit: शैलशृङ्गेषु रम्येषु देवतायतनेषु च। मृगपक्षिविघुष्टेषु रमणीयेषु सर्वदा॥२२॥
verses.english: Assuming the handsomest form, decked with all ornaments and pouring forth at times sweet music, she sported with the Pandava (Bhima) on the mountain peaks of picturesque scenery and in regions sacred to the celestial, abounding with beasts and birds. Also in forests and mountain fastness, overgrown with blossoming trees, in beautiful lake; resplendent with lotuses and lilies. On island of rivers, on the pebbled banks of streamlets, in sylvan streamlets with beautiful banks and also in mountain streams. In beautiful woods with blossoming trees, in the Himalayan bowers and in various mountains caves. In the crystal water of the lakes, smiling with lotuses, on the shores of the sea shinning with gold and pearls. In beautiful towns and fine gardens, in woods sacred to the gods and on the breast of hills. In the land of the Guhyakas and the hermitages of the ascetics on the banks of the Manasa lake, abounding with fruits and flowers of every season. Assuming the handsome form, she sported with the Pandava (Bhima). The lady with the mind like speed sported with Bhima in these places.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा च रूपं परमं सर्वाभरणभूषिता। संजल्पन्ती सुमधुरं रमयामास पाण्डवम्॥२३॥
तथैव वनदुर्गेषु पुष्पितद्रुमवल्लिषु। सरःसु रमणीयेषु पद्मोत्पलयुतेषु च॥२४॥
नदीद्वीपप्रदेशेषु वैदूर्यसिकतासु च। सुतीर्थवनतोयासु तथा गिरिनदषु च॥२५॥
काननेषु विचित्रेषु पुष्पितद्रुमवल्लिषु। हिमवद्विरिकुञ्जेषु गुहासु विविधासु च॥२६॥
प्रफुल्लशतपत्रेषु सरःस्वमलवारिषु। सागरस्थप्रदेशेषु मणिहेमचितेषु च॥२७॥
पल्वलेषु च रम्येषु महाशालवनेषु च। देवारण्यषु पुण्येषु तथा पर्वतसानुषु॥२८॥
गुह्यकानां निवासेषु तापसायतनेषु च। सर्वर्तुफलरम्येषु मानसेषु सरःसु च॥२९॥
विभ्रती परमं रूपं रमयामास पाण्डवम्। रमयन्ती तथा भीमं तत्र तत्र मनोजवा॥३०॥
प्रजज्ञे राक्षसी पुत्रं भीमसेनान्महाबलम्। विरूपाक्षं महावक्त्रं शङ्कुकर्णं बिभीषणम्॥३१॥
verses.english: She then gave birth by Bhima a greatly strong son of terrible eyes and large mouth, of ears like arrows and of appearance fearful.

verses.sanskrit: भीमनादं सुताम्रोष्ठं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं महाबलम्। महेष्वासं महावीर्यं महासत्त्वं महाभुजम्॥३२॥
verses.english: Of roaring voice, of lips brown as copper, of teeth sharp and keen. He was mighty armed, greatly energetic, exceedingly powerful and a great car warrior. Having long nose, broad chest, frightfully swelling calves, celerity of motion and excessive strength, he had nothing human in him, though born of a man. He excelled all the Pishachas and other such creatures and also the Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: महाजवं महाकायं महामायमरिंदमम्। दीर्घघोणं महोरस्कं विकटोद्वद्धपिण्डिकम्॥३३॥
अमानुषं मानुषजं भीमवेगं महाबलम्। यः पिशाचानतीत्यान्यान्बभूवातीव राक्षसान् ॥३४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: दीर्घघोणं दीर्घनासिकम् । विकटे वक्रे उद्वद्धे उच्चे पिण्डिके जानुगुल्फान्तरे पाश्चात्यप्रदेशः पिण्डिका ते द्वे यस्य तं विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकम् ॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: बालोऽपि यौवनं प्राप्तो मानुषेषु विशांपते। सर्वास्त्रेषु परं वीरः प्रकर्षमगमद्वली॥३५॥
verses.english: He grew up to be a youth when he was a boy and that mighty hero soon acquainted high proficiency in all arms and weapons known amongst mankind.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यो हि गर्भान्राक्षस्यो लभन्ते प्रसवन्ति च। कामरूपधराश्चैव भवन्ति बहुरूपिकाः॥३६॥
verses.english: The Rakshasas women give birth on the very day they conceive; they are capable of assuming any form at will and they change their forms (at will).

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य विकचः पादावगृह्णात्स पितुस्तदा। मातुश्च परमेष्वासस्तौ च नामास्य चक्रतुः॥३७॥
verses.english: That bad featured child, that mighty bowman, soon after his birth, bowed down to his mother and also to his father and touched their feet. They then named him.

verses.sanskrit: घटो हारयोत्कच इति माता तं प्रत्यभाषत। अब्रवीत्तेन नामास्य घटोत्कच इति स्म ह॥३८॥
verses.english: His mother said, "This child's head is like a Ghata (water pot)." They then gave him the name of Ghatotkacha.

verses.sanskrit: अनुरक्तश्च तानासीत्पाण्डवान्स घटोत्कचः। तेषां च दयितो नित्यमात्मनित्यो बभूव ह॥३९॥
verses.english: Ghatotkacha was (very much) attached to the Pandavas. he became a great favourite with them, almost one of them.
verses.bhavadeepa: घट इति । घटसादृश्याद्घटः शिरः । ‘घटः समाधिभेदे ना शिरः कूटकटेषु च’ इति मेदिनी । ह स्पष्टम् अस्य पुत्रस्य उत्कचः विकेशो यतस्ततो घटः उत्कचो यस्येति योगाद्घटोत्कच इति नामाब्रवीत् ॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: संवाससमयो जीर्ण इत्याभाष्य ततस्तु तान् । हिडिम्बा समयं कृत्वा स्वां गतिं प्रत्यपद्यत॥४०॥
verses.english: Knowing that the period of her stay with the (Pandava) had come to an end, Hidimba making another agreement with them went away wherever she like.

verses.sanskrit: घटोत्कची महाकायः पाण्डवान्पृथया सह। अभिवाद्य यथान्यायमब्रवीच्च प्रभाष्यताम्॥४१॥
verses.english: Thereafter giant Ghatotkacha bowed down to the Pandavas with Kunti, and told them, O sinless great men, you may tell me what I have to do. Thus addressed by him, Kunti spoke to the scn of Bhima.
verses.bhavadeepa: संवाससमयः सहवासकालः जीर्णोऽतीतः पुत्रोत्पत्तिपर्यन्तमेव तस्य कृतत्वात् ॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: किं करोम्यहमार्याणां निःशङ्कं वदतानघाः। तं ब्रुवन्तं भैमसेनिं कुन्ती वचनमब्रवीत्॥४२॥
त्वं कुरूणां कुले जातः साक्षाद्भीमसमो ह्यसि। ज्येष्ठः पुत्रोऽसि पञ्चानां साहाय्यं कुरु पुत्रक॥४३॥
verses.english: You are born in the race of Kuru and are the same as Bhima. You are the eldest son of five. O son! help us.

verses.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच । पृथयाऽप्येवमुक्तस्तु प्रणम्यैव वचोऽब्रवीत्। यथा हि रावणो लोके इन्द्रजिच्च महाबलः। वर्ष्मवीर्यसमो लोके विशिष्टश्चाभवं नृषु॥४४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed by Kunti, he replied respectfully-Just as there are in this world Ravana and Meghanada who were very strong, so also I am gigantic and valorous among the men of this world; in fact I am greater than any.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्यकाल उपस्थास्ये पितॄनिति घटोत्कचः। आमन्त्र्य रक्षसां श्रेष्ठः प्रतस्थे चोत्तरां दिशम्॥४५॥
verses.english: That best Rakshasas, Ghatotkacha, promising to come when required for business, went away towards the north.

verses.sanskrit: स हि सृष्टो मघवता शक्तिहेतोर्महात्मना। कर्णस्याप्रतिवीर्यस्य प्रतियोद्धा महारथः॥४६॥
verses.english: That great car warrior (Ghatotkacha) was created by the illustrious Indra as a proper antagonist of Karna of matchless power in consequence of the weapon (he gave him).
